apcoholdings-apcoholdings:lever:2caec3e7.title: Fixed Operations Specialist
apcoholdings-apcoholdings:lever:2caec3e7.description: APCO Holdings partners with dealerships across North America to deliver innovative vehicle protection products and services that enhance the ownership experience for customers and drive growth for our partners. Through our family of brands, we bring together industry expertise, technology, and data-driven insights to help dealers strengthen their finance and insurance performance and build lasting relationships with their customers. Our teams work collaboratively across operations, technology, risk, finance, marketing, and sales to deliver solutions that create measurable value and support the continued growth of APCO and the partners we serve. We are looking for a Fixed Operations Specialist to serve as a trusted advisor to our dealership partners. In this field-based role, you will work directly with dealership service departments to improve performance, strengthen customer retention strategies, provide training and coaching, and help dealerships maximize the value of APCO's programs and services.
responsibilities: Dealer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealership leadership, service managers, advisors, and staff
Serve as a trusted resource and consultant for dealership fixed operations teams
Develop retention strategies that strengthen existing dealer partnerships and support revenue growth
Identify opportunities to improve dealership performance and customer experience
Training & Performance Coaching
Conduct one-on-one development sessions with service personnel and leadership
Support dealerships in implementing effective customer retention and service lane processes
Reinforce performance expectations and operational best practices through ongoing coaching and follow-up
Compliance & Operational Support
Provide guidance and support related to APCO products, processes, and service center operations
Communicate effectively with dealership personnel to execute initiatives and drive results
Territory Management
Travel regularly to dealerships to provide onsite support, coaching, and consultation
Prioritize activities and manage schedules independently to maximize effectiveness
Track activity, opportunities, and dealer engagement to support retention and growth objectives
qualifications: Minimum of 2 years of automotive service center experience
Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
Ability to travel within assigned territory
Valid driver's license and ability to safely operate a motor vehicle
Experience as a Service Manager, Fixed Operations Manager, GSM, or General Manager
Experience in automotive sales, service training, dealership consulting, or vendor services

This is a field-based position requiring up to 80% overnight travel throughout an assigned territory. The role involves visiting dealership locations, conducting onsite training and coaching, and supporting dealership operations in person.

claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:9f555ce6-.title: University Business Development Representative
claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:9f555ce6-.description: University Business Development Rep Location Open to Remote in ET or CT Locations ONLY About Us Clasp is a mission-driven, venture-backed startup transforming access to education and career pathways—starting with the healthcare workforce. By enabling employers to invest in future talent where it matters most—easing overwhelming student debt—our platform creates lasting bonds between employers and employees. We believe that when employers have a stake in the cost of education, we can create a more sustainable, equitable, and skilled workforce. Fresh off our Series B, we’re entering our next phase of growth. Clasp is a Forbes Fintech 50 company, an SHRM portfolio company, and has been named by Business Insider as one of the “Top 14 Healthcare Startups to Watch in 2026” and one of the “43 Startups to Bet Your Career On in 2025.” We’re not just building a fintech product—we’re driving economic mobility. If you’re excited to build, grow, and make a real impact, join us. What We Need The Business Development Rep at Clasp is responsible for building relationships with Universities to develop deep partnerships and build awareness for Clasp. You'll build and manage a portfolio of school and program partnerships — engaging program directors, career services contacts, and financial aid offices to secure active, ongoing communication of Clasp opportunities to their students. This is a true high-volume sales job: 60% of time to be spent on cold outreach, and 40% on building/developing/nurturing existing relationships – with clear weekly and quarterly targets. You'll spend most of your time on the phone and in virtual meetings with school contacts, managing a pipeline of partner institutions from first outreach through active distribution. The role is also up to 40% travel - with the expectation that you’ll go visit schools in person to meet with administrators and students, as well as attend career fairs. There is also a requirement to travel to full company meet ups 3x per year. What You’ll Do - Conduct one-on-one calls with school administrators, program directors, and career services contacts per week - Execute daily outbound outreach to schools and programs (calls, email sequences, follow-ups) to build new distribution partnerships, resulting in a targeted number of new applicants sourced per week - Create plans with schools to share Clasp opportunities with their students and follow through to confirmed distribution - Execute campus visits, career fairs and virtual lunch & learns - Secure testimonials per quarter from satisfied partner institutions - Explore deep, creative partnerships with schools to build a strong foundation for Clasp pathways - Maintain accurate records of all school and student interactions in CRM, tracking commitment status and distribution evidence - Partner with Marketing to develop role-based assets (landing pages, co-branded materials, social graphics) that improve school distribution and student conversion - Report on outreach activity, pipeline health, and application volume on a regular basis What You’ll Need - Scrappy, resilient, positive attitude - 2–3+ years of experience in outreach, business development, partnerships, or higher-ed engagement - Comfort with high-volume outreach and structured follow-up (calling + sequencing) - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including storytelling and persuasion / sales skills - Strong relationship-building skills with school administrators, program directors, and career services contacts - Organized and data-fluent: able to use CRM dashboards to prioritize work, track outcomes, and report clearly - Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM - Experience partnering with marketing teams on conversion-driving assets and messaging What We Give In Return - Competitive cash and equity compensation - Health benefits (health, dental, & vision), 401k - Commuter benefits - Flexible PTO policy - Opportunities to grow and perform in a fast-paced environment alongs

heritageholding-heritage-holding:ashbyhq.title: Structural Engineer, Client Relationship Management
heritageholding-heritage-holding:ashbyhq.description: STRUCTURAL ENGINEER, CLIENT RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT Company: Confidential Location: Illinois (Onsite) Employment Type: Full-time ABOUT THE FIRM Heritage Holding is working with a well-established structural engineering consulting firm serving architecture firms, building owners, and developers. The firm has built a strong reputation for providing structural design and forensic engineering services for buildings and special structures, delivering highly detailed, fully constructible drawings that minimize change orders and keep projects on schedule. The company maintains long-term relationships with architecture-firm clients across both new construction and renovation projects. The company name is being withheld at this stage of the search and will be shared with candidates who advance in the process. POSITION OVERVIEW The firm is seeking a Structural Engineer – Client Relations to blend hands-on structural engineering with day-to-day ownership of key client relationships. The ideal candidate is a technically capable structural engineer who is equally comfortable in front of clients, managing accounts, and coordinating project delivery. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for a portfolio of architecture-firm and building-owner clients - Perform structural engineering design, analysis, and drawing review on building projects - Coordinate project scope, schedule, and deliverables between clients and internal engineering staff - Identify opportunities to expand and deepen existing client relationships - Prepare proposals, fee estimates, and scope documents in partnership with firm leadership - Attend client meetings, site visits, and project coordination calls as the face of the firm - Collaborate with senior engineers on technical quality control for assigned projects REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering (or closely related field) - 7–10 years of structural engineering experience, including buildings and special structures - Demonstrated experience managing client relationships directly and independently - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong presence in client-facing settings - Solid working knowledge of applicable building codes and structural design standards - Ability to manage multiple projects and client accounts simultaneously PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Active Structural Engineer (SE) license (not required, but a plus) - Prior experience working directly with architecture firms as primary clients - Business development or account-growth experience - Familiarity with AutoCAD and/or Revit structural workflows

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0531ff5e-9789-.title: Customer Success Manager, DFR Mid-Market
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0531ff5e-9789-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success Manager, DFR Mid-Market based in the United States. This role is an opportunity to help public safety organizations successfully adopt and expand the use of advanced autonomous drone technology. You will own the customer journey across implementation, onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion for a portfolio of mid-market accounts. Working at the intersection of customers, sales, product, and engineering, you will translate operational needs into actionable solutions and product feedback. You will build trusted relationships with public safety and law enforcement customers while ensuring technology and services deliver measurable value. The role combines strategic account management, hands-on project leadership, technical collaboration, and proactive customer engagement. You will have significant ownership over customer outcomes in a fast-moving environment where customer insights can directly influence future products and services. The position is remote-friendly, with a strong preference for candidates supporting Northeast accounts and located near a major airport. Own implementation, onboarding, product adoption, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of mid-market public safety customers. Build scalable customer onboarding and post-sales processes that create consistent, high-quality customer experiences. Lead implementation projects from planning through successful delivery, coordinating technology, services, timelines, and stakeholders. Establish proactive customer engagement through regular check-ins, metrics-based outreach, and structured success plans. Develop deep relationships with customers and become a trusted advisor on their operational use cases, challenges, and technology needs. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and other strategic customer meetings to demonstrate value, identify opportunities, and maintain strong relationships. Monitor customer health, identify renewal risks early, and work proactively with customers to improve retention. Partner with sales and customers to identify expansion opportunities and address industry-specific barriers that could prevent growth. Gather, quantify, and communicate customer feedback to product and engineering teams, helping influence improvements to hardware, software, and services. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and other technical teams to ensure customer needs are translated into effective solutions. Requirements Demonstrated experience supporting customers within SLED environments, particularly public safety or law enforcement. Proven experience implementing and deploying new technology while coordinating with agile development and technical teams to meet customer schedules. Track record of driving implementation, adoption, and measurable value for hardware or software products in large enterprise environments. Experience managing customer relationships remotely through proactive, structured, and metrics-driven customer success programs. Strong project management skills, including familiarity with project management tools, processes, and delivery methodologies. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, executives, sales teams, engineers, and other stakeholders. Experience working with commercial Unmanned Aircraft Systems and related software development or deployment is highly desirable. Strong ownership mentality and ability to manage multiple customer priorities in a fast-moving environment. Ability to identify customer risks, communicate them clearly, and drive cross-functional resolution. Ability to travel 25% or more, particularly to support customers and accounts across the Northeast. Ability to obtain a Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate. Candidates based in New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Virgi

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8005a8a9-d269-.title: AWS Cloud Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8005a8a9-d269-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Cloud Engineer based in United States. This is a mid-level cloud engineering role focused on designing, deploying, and optimizing AWS environments for diverse client needs. You’ll work across a variety of cloud engagements, adapting solutions to different business requirements and technical challenges. The role combines hands-on infrastructure engineering with client advisory responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence cloud architecture and implementation. You’ll leverage infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containerization, and automation to build reliable and scalable cloud environments. You’ll also identify infrastructure issues, improve performance and costs, and apply strong security practices throughout project delivery. The environment is dynamic and technology-focused, with opportunities to work across modern AWS services and evolving cloud technologies. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and delivering practical cloud solutions for clients. Deploy, configure, and maintain modular cloud-based systems and infrastructure within AWS environments. Advise clients on the design, architecture, and implementation of modern AWS cloud technologies aligned with their business requirements. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure and application deployment challenges across cloud environments. Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management practices. Implement and maintain CI/CD processes using tools such as GitLab, CircleCI, and GitHub Actions. Configure Kubernetes clusters and support application deployments within containerized environments. Design and maintain secure AWS networking environments, including VPC configurations and related security controls. Optimize cloud operations by identifying opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Ensure data storage and processing solutions meet client requirements, policies, and operational standards. Apply AWS security best practices throughout architecture, deployment, configuration, and ongoing operations. Stay current with emerging AWS services, cloud engineering practices, automation technologies, and industry standards. Collaborate with engineering teams and clients to deliver effective solutions and adapt quickly to changing project requirements. Requirements Demonstrated experience working as a Cloud Engineer, AWS Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or in a closely related infrastructure role. Hands-on experience deploying and configuring AWS cloud resources in production or client environments. Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform and/or CloudFormation . Practical experience building or supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, CircleCI, GitHub Actions , or comparable platforms. Experience configuring Kubernetes clusters and deploying applications in containerized environments. Solid understanding of AWS networking, VPC architecture, and cloud security principles. Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and application deployment issues using structured analytical and problem-solving approaches. Experience identifying opportunities for AWS performance, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure automation and configuration management practices. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and provide practical recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Strong adaptability and willingness to work across varied client environments and business requirements. An AWS Associate- or Professional-level certification is preferred. Strong commitment to cloud security, industry standards, and infrastructure best practices. Benefits Expected base salary of $105,000–$120,000 USD annually , depend

southparkcommons-orb:ashbyhq:32543c53-7e.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure - San Francisco HQ
southparkcommons-orb:ashbyhq:32543c53-7e.description: About Orb: We’re a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We’re building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence. Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you’ll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar. For San Francisco Bay Area , New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. For remote roles, we ask you to join us in person 1x per quarter. Our values, customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together are at the core of everything we do. About the role: As a member of the infrastructure team, you’ll play a key role in maintaining a high bar for reliability. Our customers depend on our systems being operational, as downtime can directly lead to lost revenue. You’ll be responsible for the infrastructure powering the entire product, from event ingestion, API services, alerting, invoicing, and everything in between. In this role you will: - Lead infrastructure resiliency efforts - recovery mechanisms, tenant isolation, load spike handling, etc - Improve observability and operability of our systems - Build performance-critical, user-facing infrastructure (eg. real-time event processing) - Plan scaling initiatives to handle large customer growth - Partner with other engineering teams to ensure we build reliable product features - Learn from a talented peer group, and share your expertise About you: - You think deeply about edge cases, failure modes, bottlenecks, etc - You have a knack for investigating and debugging tricky errors and performance issues - You enjoy building scalable infrastructure for a high-growth product - You can effectively mentor fellow engineers on best practices (observability, rollout strategies, risk mitigation, etc) - You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, and you’ve worked in in the infrastructure domain for 4+ years Orb’s Tech Stack: At Orb, we believe great engineers can learn any stack, so you do not need experience with these specific tools and we encourage you to apply regardless. - Frontend: Typescript + React + Tailwind CSS - Backend: Python - Datastores: PostgreSQL + Apache Druid+ Clickhouse - Streaming Platforms: Kafka + Spark Streaming - Cloud Platform: AWS Benefits: - Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance - One Medical membership - Unlimited PTO plus an additional week off between Christmas and New Year’s - 401k plan - 16-week paid parental leave with equity vesting - Commuter stipend - Catered lunches in the office - Annual learning & development stipend - Meaningful equity in the form of stock options Equal Opportunity Employer We work with each other day in and day out, and strongly believe that building a diverse and inclusive team is key to our long-term goals and success as a company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.
